settings.title: Why Traditional Overnight Protection Disrupts Your Rest
settings.subhead: You should never have to compromise your deepest sleep just to protect your sheets.

settings.heading: Protection Designed Beyond the Ordinary Gusset.
settings.description: Traditional period underwear relies on a small central gusset that shifts when you toss, turn, or sleep on your side. FULL-SPINE ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ is engineered with continuous front-to-back protective shielding and ergonomic side contours designed to move naturally with your body all night long.
settings.caption: Full-Spine™ coverage concept illustration · preliminary factory design

settings.title: Front Shield Coverage
settings.body: Absorbent barrier extends upward past the pelvic zone to protect during restless stomach sleeping and forward shifts.

settings.title: Central High-Flow Core
settings.body: Concentrated high-absorbency core rapidly pulls in liquid and locks it deep inside to prevent wet skin contact.

settings.title: Extended Rear Full-Spine™ Coverage
settings.body: Continuous protective barrier runs across the full rear seat all the way up to the waistband, guarding against nighttime back leaks.

settings.title: SideSeal™ Contoured Leg Edges
settings.body: Ergonomic leg openings contour smoothly to your thighs to help manage lateral migration as you curl up or sleep on your side.

settings.title: 5 Layers of Overnight Protection
settings.description: A powerful, multi-layer design that absorbs, locks, and helps prevent leaks so you can sleep with confidence.

settings.title: Engineered for Every Way You Sleep
settings.description: We do not sleep in rigid still positions. FULL-SPINE ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ is anatomically contoured to follow your natural movement throughout the night without shifting or binding.

settings.title: Crafted for Pure Skin-to-Skin Softness
settings.description: Protection should never feel stiff or cumbersome. FULL-SPINE ULTRA OVERNIGHT™ is engineered with soft-drape modal knit and flatlock seams designed to feel as effortless as luxury loungewear.

settings.title: Why Women Choose Multi-Pair Bundles
settings.subhead: One pair gets you through tonight. A multi-pair pack gives you peace of mind throughout your entire cycle.
